## What and why

## Checklist (see AGENTS.md)
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes
- [ ] Skills stay English, imperative and tool-neutral; no new hard dependency on one vendor
- [ ] `SKILL.md` under 500 lines, description under 1024 characters with no `: `
- [ ] Changes to template headings, table headers or enums updated the validator, the example and the tests together
- [ ] Changes to a script have a test in `tests/`
- [ ] No private data (e-mail addresses, local paths, secrets, customer data)
- [ ] No claim of a capability that is not implemented or verified
